item.title: Pentagon hosts first-ever Israeli–Lebanese military talks aimed at curbing Hezbollah
item.description: Israeli and Lebanese military delegations open U.S.-brokered talks at the Pentagon focused on ceasefire enforcement and border stability amid tensions.

item.title: Israel's military eliminates Hamas terrorist who helped abduct American-Israeli hostage, 3 others
item.description: The IDF announced it killed a Hamas Nukhba terrorist who participated in the abduction of hostage Hersh Goldberg-Polin during the Oct. 7 attack.

item.title: Hezbollah's 'game changing' night-hunting weapon punches through Israel's defenses: expert
item.description: Drone expert warns Hezbollah's nighttime drone capabilities are game changing, using thermal sensors to target IDF troops under cover of darkness.

item.title: Hamas struggles to fill leadership ranks as Israel hunts Oct 7 terrorists
item.description: Hours after an Israeli airstrike killed Hamas military wing chief Mohammed Odeh, Gaza's Eid markets were full, revealing a disconnect with Hamas.

item.title: Israel eliminates head of Hamas' military wing in Gaza strike
item.description: Israeli forces killed Mohammed Odeh, the new head of Hamas' military wing, in an airstrike in northern Gaza, according to the Israel Defense Forces.

item.title: Israeli ambassador compares France's far-left leader's rhetoric to Hitler as antisemitism surges
item.description: France recorded 1,320 antisemitic acts in 2025, up from 436 in 2022, as Jewish families alter daily habits to avoid being identified, CRIF's president says.

item.title: Israel accuses UN of placing it on same sexual violence blacklist as Hamas terrorists, severs ties
item.description: Israeli officials blast the U.N. after accusing the body of placing Israel on a sexual violence blacklist that also includes Hamas and other terrorist groups.

item.title: US ally Kuwait condemns 'brutal and ongoing Iranian attacks' after airport was hit
item.description: Kuwait has condemned "the brutal and ongoing Iranian attacks using ballistic missiles and drones," saying Kuwait International Airport had been targeted.

item.title: Israeli official says EU sanctions reveal antisemitism hiding behind 'socially acceptable mask'
item.description: Israel's Deputy Foreign Minister accuses the EU of disguising antisemitism as anti-Zionism after sanctions hit Israeli civil society organizations.

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei touts new anti-US alliance as Gulf backchannels seep into Tehran: analyst
item.description: Iran's supreme leader launched a sweeping counteroffensive against President Donald Trump, seeking to rally Middle Eastern nations into an anti-American alliance, an analyst says.
